retention_notes: Every process is retained with its warmup and measured batches; no outlier was removed.

Paths are normalized: $CHECKOUT is the measured checkout (ec442a20), $SCRATCH a private scratch directory holding the AOT executables (final/jrbench/exe/) and the pristine upstream checkout (upstream/json_repair).
The 2 November measurement of main c3aaa068 (non-ASCII 0.91-1.01x, malformed 5.3x) is superseded by this one; it remains in this file's history (commit 039276eb).
